a.lede: Over 1,600 PS4 and PS5 games have been made free on jailbroken PS5 units thanks to Overdrive. The homebrew was quickly shut down after going viral, but was quickly revived through forks and re-releases under new accounts.
a.title: PS5 homebrew storefront with over 1,600 free PS5 and PS4 games taken down by Sony

b.lede: Modder Sword has released PS5SX2 for the PlayStation 5, allowing gamers to play discs from previous PlayStation 2 games.
b.title: PS5 hack delivers native PS2 disc support and 4K upscaling where Sony refused to
